scope_note: This is a fresh manual review of Candidate 5 round 4, using the same immutable executable as round 3. All 35 expanded images and six capability images listed below were opened directly from the new round-4 directory with view_image, and their own round-4 sidecars were read. No earlier-round image substitutes for a round-4 inspection. Selection counts, queue states, enabled actions, stable dialog paging, summary context and notice placement agree with the reviewed sidecars. No new finding was identified in this assigned subset. Complete-round and native acceptance remain owned by the parent review; this report does not declare an overall clean round or the review-loop exit condition complete.

coverage_limits: The no-frontlight reader capture has its menu closed. Hiding the brightness menu button was confirmed statically in the earlier source review, not by an open-menu capability screenshot in this subset.
The closed-reader active worker-notice matrix is separate evidence owned by the parent review; its reported automated pass count is not represented as a manual inspection by this supporting reviewer.
Cache clear and offline cover screenshots do not certify throughput, cache lock fairness, file integrity or physical-device performance.
Native park and wake behavior remains owned by separate firmware verification. This supporting review does not declare the overall phase or its clean-round exit condition complete.
execution_note: No application, build, test suite, smoke test or runtime probe was executed by this reviewer. Only existing local screenshots, sidecars and source files were read; no production file was changed.
